<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex088052025-05-2615-57-58" status="finalized"> <milestone unit="section" n="221.31 yang dag rtags kyi mtshan nyid tshul gsum bye brag tu bshad pa"/>
         dang po <lb n="15b8"/> la 2 te |<abbr>mtshan nyid</abbr> ngos bzung pa dang | de <abbr>mtshan nyid</abbr> du 'gyur tshul lo ||
         <milestone unit="section" n="221.311 mtshan nyid ngos bzung pa"/>
         dang po la | phyogs chos ni grub bsal <abbr>med</abbr> pa'i gzhi la rtags dbyer <abbr>med</abbr> kyi ldog pa tha dad du rten par tshad mas nges pa <note type="gloss"><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3831">phya</rs> <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3807">'bre</rs></note> zer ba ni ma yin te | stong nyid la sgrub chos ma dor bas ma yin dgag du sgrub pa na grub bsal <abbr>med</abbr> pa'i stong nyid la brtags te dbyer <abbr>med</abbr> kyi ldog pa tha dad du yod pas phyogs <pb n="16a"/><lb n="16a1"/> chos yod par thal ba'i phyir ro ||</seg></TEI>
